Kingdom Come: Deliverance II — Cross-Platform Buying Guide

Xbox / PS5 / PC · Updated 2026-08-05

Kingdom Come: Deliverance II is Warhorse's 2025 sequel — a historically grounded, no-magic medieval RPG with a huge branching story and brutally realistic combat.

Standard vs Gold Edition

  • Standard — the full game
  • Gold Edition — bundles the season pass for future story DLC; buy if you plan to stick around for the expansions
  • No hand-holding — a hard RPG; saves are limited and combat is skill-based

Where to buy cheapest

A 2025 release, KCD2's key-store price on Green Man Gaming undercuts the console stores. The first real discounts land a few months after launch — worth waiting for if you're not in a rush.

  • Check on Amazon
